name: jengo/pesa
description: Unified multi-gateway payment processing subsystem for CodeIgniter 4 and the Jengo Framework with M-Pesa Daraja 3.0, Pesapal v3, Stripe, and Flutterwave support.

gateways.name: mpesa
gateways.description: Safaricom Daraja 3.0 driver supporting STK Push, C2B URL registration & confirmation, B2C disbursements, and status queries.

gateways.name: pesapal
gateways.description: Pesapal v3 API driver for hosted checkout, mobile money, cards, and IPN status tracking.

gateways.name: stripe
gateways.description: Stripe driver for hosted checkout sessions, card payments, and webhook signature verification.

gateways.name: fake
gateways.description: In-memory mock gateway for unit testing and CI pipelines.

dtos.description: Data Transfer Object for initiating an M-Pesa STK Push prompt on customer phones.
Data Transfer Object containing STK Push initiation results and checkoutRequestId.
Data Transfer Object for creating hosted checkout payment links (Pesapal, Stripe).
Data Transfer Object containing redirect URL and reference for hosted checkout.
Data Transfer Object for initiating B2C payouts or salary disbursements.
Data Transfer Object containing payout dispatch status and conversation IDs.
Data Transfer Object representing transaction status query results and receipt numbers.

events.description: Dispatched when a payment transaction is started and recorded in the ledger.
Dispatched upon verified successful payment callback/webhook or transaction query.
Dispatched when a payment fails or is rejected by user/provider.
Dispatched when a completed payment transaction is reversed.

commands.description: Registers C2B validation and confirmation URLs with Safaricom Daraja 3.0 API.
Runs automated installation, publishes Config/Pesa.php, and migrates the pesa_transactions table.

usage_examples.title: M-Pesa STK Push
Hosted Checkout (Pesapal / Stripe)
